questions.question:
Three coins are tossed once. Find the probability of getting:
(i) 3 heads
(ii) 2 heads
(iii) at least 2 heads
(iv) at most 2 heads
(v) no head
solutionSteps: Sample Space (8): HHH, HHT, HTH, THH, HTT, THT, TTH, TTT.
(iii) At least 2 Heads: {HHT, HTH, THH, HHH} (4). Prob = 4/8 = 1/2.
(iv) At most 2 Heads: All except HHH (7). Prob = 7/8.

questions.question:
Case Study: A bag contains 5 Red, 6 White and 7 Black balls. One ball is drawn at random.
(i) Find the probability that the ball drawn is Red or White.
(ii) Find the probability that the ball drawn is not Black.
(iii) Find the probability that the ball drawn is neither Red nor White.
solutionSteps: (ii) Not Black = Red or White = 11. Prob = 11/18.
(iii) Neither Red nor White = Black = 7. Prob = 7/18.
